items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Was a guitar player that was with (inaudible) -- John Smith, played banjo.

ctx.x: And he got, I mean, real things. So we took them away and let John Smith take them in his basement
and he give a receipt to me for the estate to keep them because somebody would take them. I was with him when he went and bought . Who's Charlie Smith?

Was a guitar player that was with (inaudible) -- John Smith, played banjo. He was a good (inaudible) and he died, too. So, he's got a lot of the things now. Took . He's got a 15 or 20 mikes, you know, and two of them I opened up and they cost $100 apiece. I don't know what they were for. Big gold mikes. Paid $100 a mike. Now, if ever he's going to use them, I don't know. But we got all that stuff. (Inaudible).
